name: 44067 · Northfield, OH
findings: ZIP 44067 (Northfield) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44067 (Northfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44067 (Northfield) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).
